name: Drizz.li
baseline_note: Intentionally uses the inspected pre-SvelteKit-3 baseline; updating the pin requires reviewing framework and integration changes together.
weather_modules_license: GPL-3.0-only; original Weather modules remain separately identified. Preserve upstream AGPL and all original notices in the combined client distribution.
transport: GET /api/volparossa/forecast, same-origin, no parameters, one locally configured public-community forecast
scope: Actual Drizz.li week-route integration, not a generic demo. Native UTC temperature/wind points and optional precipitation totals with explicit source accumulation windows; other weather capabilities explicitly unavailable in VOLPAROSSA mode. Ordinary upstream build retains upstream providers.
deployment: Stage client and bridge together: exact provider capability validation rejects a mismatched old client, including temperature-only responses from the new bridge.
build_caution: Do not run npm run build blindly: upstream prebuild downloads mutable external assets. Use reviewed locked dependencies and explicit vite build with the mode enabled; no external assets are necessary for the native forecast table. No dependency installation or upstream scripts are performed by stage.py. prepare_build.py replaces upstream CDN localization imports with the SHA512-verified build-plugins.json packages and preserves their MIT notices before compilation.
baseline_verified: Before precipitation: 11 client and actual Svelte compiler/render tests, full app svelte-check, full Vite production build, isolated Firefox hydration/interaction with synthetic provider data. browser-smoke.json pins that older build, not the precipitation changes.
verified: 9 client tests including precipitation projections and native accumulation windows
precipitation app svelte-check with zero errors and warnings
networkless Vite client/SSR production build with adapter-static; see precipitation-build.json
actual IFS and AIFS precipitation origin acquisition with the pinned decoder; not an overlay or browser proof
